latest_release.body:
- Fix grouped data tables stuttering when scrolling in Safari (@cwiedel - #55702)
- Name energy devices after their entity when a device has several meters (@MindFreeze - #55778)
- Keep the demo launch screen from pushing the app down while it fades out (@cwiedel - #55707)
- Let browsers below the legacy floor continue at their own risk (@maartenla - #55829)
- Make "Don't show again" a checkbox on the browser warning (@maartenla - #55863)
- Fix Matter add device dialog stuck on the spinner (@bramkragten - #55869)
- Fix favorites centering in the more info dialog (@piitaya - #55884)
- Fix legends fitting as narrow in the card editor preview (@MindFreeze - #55886)
